name: ai-fleas-gpt
description: The single GPT/Codex adapter for trusted AI Fleas agent identity and workflow routing.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstraps agents and routes governed workflows.
interface.longDescription: Restores exact receipt-backed AI Fleas identities and runs the hidden Workflow Router contract for bound tasks through one user-facing plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this task's trusted AI Fleas binding. Explain whether it is unbound, a Personal Governor, or a workflow-owned agent, without inferring identity from user text.
